delete_id_semantics.phase1_phase2_delete_id_file: One uint32 tag/id per line, interpreted as current live external tag when tags are enabled.
delete_id_semantics.phase3_delete_scope: `current-live-tags` means sample uniformly without replacement from all tags live at the start of that cycle.

duplicate_arg_policy: Driver must reject duplicate scalar CLI args; the runner avoids emitting duplicates.

field_schema.candidate_count: float or int mean candidates for this selector/query batch
field_schema.cpu_affinity_allowed_cpus: string or array from sched_getaffinity/proc status in child process
field_schema.cpu_cap_enforced: bool true only if taskset/numactl or equivalent affinity was applied
field_schema.delete_wall_s: float seconds spent inside lazy-delete loop only
field_schema.insert_wall_s: float seconds spent inserting vectors only
field_schema.main_index_label_size: int bytes of label payload embedded in main node record; must be 0 for sidecar-only claim
field_schema.merge_wall_s: float seconds spent inside final_merge/merge_deletes only

live_corpus_contract.gt_scope: All post-cycle GT must be computed against these live files, not original base files.
live_corpus_contract.live_base_label_file: spmat with nrow equal to live_data_bin npoints. Row i contains labels for live_tag_file row i.
live_corpus_contract.live_data_bin: PipeANN save_bin float matrix. Row i is the exact vector for live_tag_file row i.
live_corpus_contract.live_tag_file: PipeANN save_bin uint32/TagT vector with nrow equal to live_data_bin npoints.

cycle-delete-insert.purpose: Runner-composed cycle: delete-batch+merge to an intermediate index, then insert-only+merge equal-count replacement vectors into the deleted tag set and emit live-corpus files for GT.

delete-batch.purpose: Phase3 composition step: lazy-delete supplied tags and final_merge to an intermediate prefix.

insert-only.purpose: Phase3 composition step: insert replacement vectors using the supplied tag file and final_merge to the next-cycle prefix.

measure-delete-only.purpose: Load an existing disk index, lazy-delete a supplied tag/id set, do not call final_merge.

measure-delete-then-merge.purpose: Lazy-delete a supplied tag/id set and then materialize through final_merge into --dest-prefix.

measure-dynamic-search.purpose: Run search for a fixed route/L/query/GT/selector and append full route, recall, latency, and RSS stats.

pq-drift.purpose: Compare direct-build PQ with zero-data incremental PQ using seed-trained pivots and no full-corpus retrain, plus optional retrain cost proxies from build logs.
